agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Read-only inventory commands must use syntactically valid PowerShell collection and pipeline forms.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: Two foreach expressions were piped directly after their closing braces and PowerShell rejected each as an empty pipeline element.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: PowerShell parser errors occurred before output, file mutation, test execution or process launch.

correction.action: Assign each foreach result to a rows variable before piping the variable to JSON conversion.
correction.prevention_control: Use the rows-assignment inventory template for every future PowerShell foreach projection.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records two rejected read-only inventory commands and their common corrected template.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A source self-audit must not embed the exact forbidden tokens it searches for or count its own assertion token.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first guard matched its own forbidden literals; the first correction missed the equivalent subprocess-run count token and caused a second focused failure.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Two serial focused pytest runs failed closed before evidence acceptance, with every process/provider activity counter zero.

correction.action: Construct every launcher, provider, credential and subprocess-run comparison token from fragments.
correction.prevention_control: Self-auditing source checks use fragmented comparison constants and a passing focused regression test.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the self-referential guard and complete fragmented-token correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A successor packet must exclude immutable equality selectors superseded by explicitly accepted repair descendants.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first widened packet included two controller-convergence selectors fixed to the pre-repair controller digest.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The 77-test packet passed 75 tests and failed only the two historical accepted-component equality selectors.

correction.action: Freeze the two-selector applicability boundary and rerun every other current startup-lineage test.
correction.prevention_control: The attempt-005 execution packet consumes the committed historical selection document instead of reconstructing exclusions.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the superseded equality selectors and the 75-test applicable packet.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every non-empty continuity authorized opening must use the typed boundary-and-source object shape.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first closeout intent represented the exact successor opening as a free string.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The read-only clockwork check rejected at tick_transaction_prepare with authorized_opening_object_required before publication.

correction.action: Replace the string with a typed boundary, repository source and exact one-attempt scope object.
correction.prevention_control: Non-empty clockwork authorized openings are copied from the continuity graph opening schema before the next dry check.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected free-string opening and its typed-object correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every typed continuity authority opening must use an existing closed-boundary identifier.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The second closeout draft used a structurally valid but newly coined boundary name outside the graph vocabulary.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The read-only clockwork check rejected at tick_transaction_prepare with authorized_opening_boundary_unknown before publication.

correction.action: Replace the coined name with the existing model-runtime and provider-call boundaries and retain the exact one-attempt scopes.
correction.prevention_control: Select every non-empty authority opening boundary from the live graph governance closed-boundaries list before dry check.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected unknown boundary and its closed-vocabulary correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every successor latch must retain each canonical closed-surface boundary required by the baton consistency control, even when a narrower companion boundary is also present.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first published successor latch retained the narrow authored-synthetic data boundary but omitted the canonical general no-product-data boundary required by the standing consistency test.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The final postpublication governance assertion failed closed; the clockwork generation was rolled back byte-exactly before any attempt-005 preparation, Harness process or provider request.

correction.action: Retain the narrow authored-synthetic boundary and add the exact canonical no-product-data boundary before republishing.
correction.prevention_control: Run the focused current-baton closed-surface assertion against the prepared successor generation before clockwork publication.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rolled-back successor-boundary omission and the restored canonical closed-surface vocabulary.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The readiness regression must recompute the stored clockwork reading only while its exact generation and lease remain live.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first postrollback regression used operation identity alone as the recomputation condition, so the restored readiness latch attempted to reuse its consumed lease-116 reading after the pointer advanced to lease 118.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The focused pytest run failed closed with clockwork_reading_mismatch and no Node, Harness, broker, provider or network process.

correction.action: Require exact generation and lease equality before recomputation; otherwise verify only the immutable stored evidence and the monotonic later lease or successor checkpoint.
correction.prevention_control: Every regression for a declared non-reusable reading gates recomputation on the reading's exact generation and lease, not merely the operation identifier.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the postrollback non-reuse guard gap and its exact generation-and-lease correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A regression must consume the exact exported clockwork-root coordinate supplied by its subject module.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first generation-and-lease guard referenced an invented CLOCKWORK_CURRENT_PATH attribute instead of the existing CLOCKWORK_ROOT/current.json coordinate.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The focused pytest run failed closed with AttributeError before deterministic recomputation, Harness startup or provider activity.

correction.action: Use the subject module's existing CLOCKWORK_ROOT joined with current.json.
correction.prevention_control: Before adding a cross-module regression coordinate, resolve and reuse an actually exported constant from the subject source.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected invented pointer constant and the exact exported-coordinate correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: When a regression is added to the focused and widened packets, its evidence counts and the assertions binding those counts must advance together.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The verification evidence advanced from 9/75 to 10/76 but the paired binding test still asserted the old counts.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The widened pytest packet failed only on the stale focused-count assertion after all preceding selectors passed.

correction.action: Update the paired assertions to 10 and 76 and search the tranche paths for every stale 9/75 literal before rerun.
correction.prevention_control: Treat verification count fields and their exact binding assertions as one mechanical edit set.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the stale paired count assertion and its mechanical synchronization control.

correction.prevention_control: Validate the complete incident-bearing intent against the clockwork schema before freezing its Git source.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected descriptive incident vocabulary and the new pre-commit admission control.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The incident revision note must use the clockwork-projected next register revision, independent of how many incidents the tick contains or how many unpublished drafts preceded it.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The correction drafts advanced the human revision filename once per added observation even though one clockwork tick advances the canonical register revision only once, from 593 to 594.

correction.action: Bind the complete incident batch to the machine-projected next revision 594 and retain all new IDs in that single note.
correction.prevention_control: Derive the human revision-note path from the prospective register projection, never from incident count or draft count.
